Assign low probability (<0.1) to all other items unless there is specific evidence of co-location. Avoid 'guessing' transient items on static surfaces.", "why": "Previous beliefs allowed for transient items (makeup, hairbrush) to be on the towel rack, leading to overestimation and score drops.
